result: Final Phase 4 source, tests, benchmarks, model manifest, database state, audit, journal, TODO and handoff records synchronized to phase4-independent-final. Latest recorded branch commit is 64f0ddbe7cfcd632639b22d8dbf96bca91d00384. No CI status is claimed for this head.

Inspected earlier Phase 4 material before acceptance. Found divergent ancestry from the independently verified Phase 3 branch, stale 38-feature metadata against authoritative 40-feature http-v2, and an inspected binary-artifact documentation claim without a corresponding artifact in the inspected tree.
Created phase4-independent-final from phase3-independent-final so the independently verified Phase 2/3 hardening remained the base.
Implemented deterministic labelled HTTP dataset and HistGradientBoostingClassifier using the 40-feature http-v2 contract. Training/evaluation are separated from request-time inference.
Implemented benign-only OneClassSVM anomaly detector with threshold learned from the benign baseline and held-out benign FPR/attack challenge evaluation.
Implemented learned per-source LogisticRegression behavioural detector with bounded sliding-window request count/rate/path-churn/inter-arrival features and process-local bounded state.
Wired EdgeWAF to signature + supervised + unsupervised + behavioural signals. Known signatures remain hard blocks. ML inference failures produce a risk=1.0 fail-closed signal.
Implemented versioned phase4-model-v1 artifact validation over http-v2 with exactly 40 feature names. Binary joblib is reproducibly generated instead of relying on an unverifiable committed binary.
Initial ML failure handling was tested and found to require explicit block semantics. Edge policy was corrected so ml-runtime-failure forces risk 1.0 and BLOCK.
Config tests still expected Phase 3 defaults after advancing the runtime to Phase 4. Tests were updated to pipeline_version=phase4 and http-v2.
Behavioural state serialization/sharing was hardened by excluding live windows from pickle state and creating a fresh bounded window per EdgeWAF runtime while reusing stateless fitted models.
Root self-test naming could collide with pytest collection. The authoritative gate is scripts/phase4_gate.py and does not use a root *_test.py name.
Full local regression passed: 53/53 tests. Python compileall passed.
Supervised holdout: accuracy=1.0 precision=1.0 recall=1.0 F1=1.0 FPR=0.0 test_n=1500. Scope is deterministic synthetic HTTP only.
Unsupervised holdout: benign FPR=0.017333 attack detection=0.888 benign_n=750 attack_n=3000. Scope is deterministic synthetic HTTP only.
Behavioural workload: normal_max=0.406313 burst_final=0.980486 escalation=true with 10 normal and 40 burst requests. Scope is deterministic synthetic behavioural workload.
Two independent deterministic model generations matched exactly at 183235 bytes and SHA-256 8fe56e23ea19a6dc2e82563b0ae4f1d0754a3df2ee5be1e4042a51910edabf50.
Latest local direct rerun: 2000 requests, 323.94 req/s, 1900 allow, 100 block, 0 alert.

Latest local E2E rerun: 1000 requests at concurrency 50, 161.89 req/s, 850 HTTP 200, 150 HTTP 403, 0 HTTP 500, 850 protected upstream hits, p50=255.985ms, p95=689.393ms. Measurements fluctuate by runtime.

Phase 3 Nginx integration was previously independently verified allow=200/block=403. Phase 4 did not change the Nginx configuration. A later combined local command timed out during the Nginx script, so no new Phase 4-specific Nginx pass is claimed beyond the inherited verified evidence.
Scoped secret/stub scans passed with no matching secret signatures or TODO/FIXME/pass no-op stubs in waf Python source.

Phase 4 100 percent gate passed locally: compileall PASS, 53/53 PASS, all three ML evaluations pass thresholds, live benign allow, live known attack block, artifact round-trip PASS, reproducibility PASS, fail-closed policy PASS.

Persisted Phase 4 state, model manifest, independent audit, master TODO, future-chat handoff, completion/test reports, architecture documentation, project state, requirements matrix and next-phase handoff under repository memory/handoff paths.
Phase 4 PASS at the required 100 percent milestone gate. Overall Challenge 3 remains IN_PROGRESS.
